name: Sprout Social
description: Sprout Social is a social media management platform for publishing, engagement, customer care, listening, and performance reporting across owned network profiles. Teams use it to coordinate social workflows and understand audience and content performance.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned machine-to-machine OAuth client from an API-enabled Sprout account, then let agents inspect bounded customer IDs, identity-redacted profile structure, and group IDs through three approval-gated tools.

credentialRequirements.name: SPROUT_SOCIAL_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Sprout Social OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a machine-to-machine OAuth client under Global Features > API in the customer-owned Sprout account.

credentialRequirements.name: SPROUT_SOCIAL_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Sprout Social OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the matching customer-owned secret. Relay encrypts it and never exposes it to agents.

capabilities.label: Read social account structure
capabilities.description: Read bounded Sprout customer, profile, and group structure metadata without customer names, network-native identity, user data, or social content.

approvalRequired.label: List Sprout customer IDs
approvalRequired.description: List at most 25 accessible Sprout customer IDs without customer names.

approvalRequired.label: List Sprout profile structure
approvalRequired.description: List at most 25 profile IDs, network types, and group counts for one exact customer without profile or network-native identity.

approvalRequired.label: List Sprout group IDs
approvalRequired.description: List at most 25 group IDs for one exact customer without group names.

blocked.label: Read Sprout or network identity
blocked.description: Customer, profile, group, user, team, queue, topic, and network-native names, IDs, descriptions, addresses, and membership are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read social content or analytics
blocked.description: Posts, messages, cases, listening, analytics, demographics, tags, and reporting data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Publish or upload media
blocked.description: Publishing posts, draft creation, media upload, and all mutations are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary Sprout APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, bodies, filters, pagination, raw responses, X data, bulk access, and exports are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All three structure reads require approval; identity, content, analytics, listening, cases, publishing, media, writes, arbitrary APIs, pagination, and export remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three metadata reads run directly; exact customer IDs, fixed origins, redaction, bounds, audits, and the provider's 60-per-minute and 250,000-per-month quotas remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway exchanges encrypted customer-owned credentials for a short-lived JWT and mounts only three redacted metadata reads.
Railway exchanges encrypted customer-owned credentials for a short-lived JWT and mounts only three redacted metadata reads.

providerSetup.blocker: Sprout API access requires an appropriate plan, Account Owner-granted API Permissions, accepted Analytics API Terms, and a customer-owned machine-to-machine OAuth client. No approved customer credentials are available for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: An eligible Sprout Account Owner must grant API Permissions, accept the API terms, create a machine-to-machine OAuth client, and connect its client ID and secret. Then validate token exchange, redaction, exact-customer denial, quotas, credential replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Official customer-managed machine-to-machine OAuth, fixed identity and API origins, organization_id scope, short-lived JWT access, customer and metadata endpoints, response structure, and quotas of 60 requests per minute and 250,000 per month.
Current plan and Account Owner permission requirements, API-token management, supported data and publishing surfaces, and exclusions.
Advanced-plan API access, API Permissions entitlement, provider-managed credential invalidation, and security guidance.

securityNotes: Relay uses the provider-recommended customer-owned machine-to-machine OAuth flow and requests only organization_id.
Customer names, profile names, native names and IDs, addresses, group names, users, teams, queues, topics, descriptions, membership, social content, and analytics are stripped or never requested.

Requests use only the documented identity token URL and https://api.sproutsocial.com, reject redirects, validate exact positive-decimal customer IDs, cap responses at 1 MB, and return at most 25 resources.

Posts, messages, cases, listening, analytics, demographics, tags, reports, publishing, media uploads, writes, arbitrary paths, request bodies, filters, pagination, raw APIs, X data, bulk, and exports are unavailable.
Sprout limits clients to 60 requests per minute and 250,000 requests per month. Relay propagates 429 responses; credential invalidation remains provider-managed.
